title: Drawer divider set
about: egg-crate dividers for a drawer that slot together with half-lap joints, laid out flat as one plate of bodies
tries: Make the compartments of the front row half as deep as the back row | Add a 10 mm finger notch to the top edge of each divider between the slots

agent.role: a drawer-organiser designer who builds dividers as flat, slotted plates
agent.prompt: Prefer half-lap slots of h / 2 + gap with a lead-in; keep dividers flat on the bed; never make a divider thinner than four line widths.

fragments.measure: Set W and D to the inside of the drawer measured with a tape; clear takes care of the ends.
fragments.copies: Copy finished dividers with .pattern(j.feat(id).body(), …) rather than repeating features.
